subject.title: [Bug]: Tool JSON Schema patternProperties causes 400 errors on BytePlus Ark (doubao) — schema cleaning should be universal, not provider-specific

question: Should BytePlus/Ark schema compatibility be implemented as provider-owned metadata, or should OpenClaw globally scrub JSON Schema keywords for all non-Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible providers?
rationale: Both directions can fix the reporter's failure, but the global scrubber changes model-facing schemas for many providers and needs explicit maintainer policy approval.

options.title: Provider-Owned Ark Compat
options.body: Add BytePlus/Ark-compatible metadata or a provider-family helper that strips `patternProperties` only for known Ark-family routes, then require targeted tests and live proof.

options.title: Global Non-Anthropic Scrubber
options.body: Make schema cleaning the default for all non-Anthropic providers, accepting the broader compatibility risk as intentional product policy.

options.title: Configurable Opt-In
options.body: Expose or document a compat flag/profile for strict OpenAI-compatible providers so BytePlus users can opt in without changing other providers.

recommendation.title: Provider-Owned Ark Compat
recommendation.body: Add BytePlus/Ark-compatible metadata or a provider-family helper that strips `patternProperties` only for known Ark-family routes, then require targeted tests and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Most of the relevant schema-compat and bundled-provider history routes through steipete, including the current compat seam and BytePlus provider package work.
